name: Entranced by Calamity
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, mesmerist 2, psychic 2, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cast the spell and implant into the target a fascination with violence and calamity. If the target fails their saving throw, for the duration, anytime that the creature sees or senses damage being dealt to a creature or object that deals more than 10 hp of damage within 30 feet, they are fascinated until the end of their next, or current if they dealt the damage, turn. At the end of their turn they are allowed a Will save to end the effect early. On a successful saving throw, either at the outset of the spell, or made during the normal duration, the next time the creature sees a qualifying violent event, it is dazzled until the end of its next turn and the spell ends.

Entranced by Calamity, Mass

School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 4, mesmerist 4, psychic 4, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as entranced by calamity, except as noted above.
